The inspected source code independently matches full 5! arrival-permutation expectations and tests 120+60 marked classes. From exact attempted-prefix means, both P5->Q and Q->K2,3 have identical p-polynomial gain p^2(7p^3-35p^2+60p-30)/30; strictly positive cubic derivative and end signs prove the unique time crossover. Classification is exhaustive only at order<=5, as claimed.
